Chapter 832: Chapter 28: Return (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 832: Chapter 28: Return (Please Subscribe)

“Alright.”

“This time, besides congratulating you on reaching the Tenth Stage.”

“There is another matter.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the numerous Evil Gods below, as well as the Child of the Void drenched in cold sweat; with a thought, he restored the surrounding space and time.

To Lin Yuan now, whether the Child of the Void had reached the Tenth Stage or not made little difference; neither posed a significant challenge to him.

When Lin Yuan first grasped the Sixth Realm of time and space, his combat power had already surpassed a Ninth Stage Evil God, let alone after a century of arduous cultivation?

...

A hundred years ago, the Child of the Void was no match for Lin Yuan, and a hundred years later, the gap between them only grew wider; even if the Child of the Void fortuitously ascended to the Tenth Stage, it was far from sufficient to bridge the divide.

Of course.

Lin Yuan thought it could not be bridged, but perhaps the Child of the Void didn’t see it that way.

Therefore, upon Lin Yuan’s arrival, he directly exerted his authority to make the Child of the Void realize his position.

Now, it seemed the effect was quite satisfactory.

“Martial Ancestor, please speak.”

The Child of the Void immediately said respectfully.

Freed from the suppression of the stillness of space and time, the Child of the Void felt significantly more relaxed, but inside, it was as if he was in a dream.

Having stepped into the Tenth Stage, the Child of the Void thought he would achieve a corresponding status, but now, it seemed no different from before his breakthrough.

“You and the other Evil Gods must take an oath to not initiate an attack on any Martial Tao cultivator within the next hundred billion years.”

Lin Yuan spoke.

With his return imminent, Lin Yuan naturally intended to eradicate any final hidden dangers.

That was to prevent these Foreign Evil Gods from harboring any other notions after his departure.

While the Ancestral Demon Tree could still seek Lin Yuan’s assistance, it would still be a waste of World-Breaking Origin Force.

This descent not only solved the crisis of the Tianqing World and considerably spread Martial Tao but also brought enormous improvements to his own cultivation.

It could be said to be a full harvest.

But a future descent would not yield such gains.

To minimize any chance of mishaps, Lin Yuan naturally made preparations, compelling all Evil Gods to take the corresponding oaths.

An oath, as referred to in the Spirit Realm, is known as a heart oath in the Boundless Void; it is made to resonate with the laws of the Dao through the vow, thereby binding oneself.

Lin Yuan compelled these Foreign Evil Gods to take oaths, rather than killing them to eliminate future troubles, as this would exert sufficient pressure on Martial Tao cultivators.

Under pressure, there will be motivation, and Martial Tao can develop more vigorously.

Why the restraint of a hundred billion years? If, after a hundred billion years, Martial Tao still fails to produce a cultivator who can match a Ninth Stage Evil God.

Then Lin Yuan would indeed have to ponder whether the issue lies with the Martial Tao system he created.

And even after a hundred billion years, given Lin Yuan’s deterrence, it’s highly likely the Child of the Void wouldn’t dare make a move.

After a hundred billion years, even considering the six hundred-fold difference in the flow of time between the Boundless Void and the Main Universe, millions of years would have also passed there.

If Lin Yuan hasn’t successfully assaulted the ultimate border by then, he probably would have failed and perished along the way.

Under such circumstances, the fate of the Martial Tao Cultivation System is no longer Lin Yuan’s concern.

“Good.”

The Child of the Void agreed without any hesitation.

The other Perfect Demon True Lords also showed no doubt.

What a joke; even without the restraint of the oath, with Martial Ancestor Lin Yuan overseeing them, these Evil Gods wouldn’t dare touch a Martial Tao cultivator no matter how bold they were.

Soon, all the Evil Gods took their oaths before Lin Yuan, invoking a response from the Boundless Void.

Finally, Lin Yuan gave one last look at the many Evil Gods and vanished without a trace.

Long after Lin Yuan’s departure did the Child of the Void dare to straighten up and look around.

“Has the Martial Ancestor left?”

The Child of the Void let out a huge sigh of relief internally.

“Martial Ancestor… what level of power does he truly possess?” the Child of the Void swallowed nervously.

When he hadn’t broken through to the Tenth Stage, facing the Martial Ancestor already required enduring immense pressure.

But now that he had reached the Tenth Stage, facing the Martial Ancestor felt even more pressure than prior to his breakthrough.

“Could it be the Eleventh Stage? The Twelfth Stage?”

The Child of the Void rapidly speculated in his mind, as the power displayed by Lin Yuan was nothing short of divine wrath compared to that of an ordinary Tenth Stage.

The Child of the Void, in addition to reaching the Tenth Stage himself, also had access to detailed descriptions of the Tenth Stage left by the founders of ancient secret realms.

After stepping into the Tenth Stage, the Child of the Void felt that he fitted the founders’ descriptions well, but Lin Yuan?

The Child of the Void was at a loss for understanding.

“Great Child of the Void…”

Just as the Child of the Void was lost in turbulent thoughts.

A Perfect Demon True Lord below couldn’t help but tentatively speak up.

They had all come to congratulate the Child of the Void on entering the Tenth Stage, to bask in the presence of the Martial Ancestor.

However, judging by the recent scene, all hopes harbored by the Evil Gods were likely to be unfulfilled forever.

“You all may leave.”

The Child of the Void said listlessly, feeling that he might have been better off not breaking through to the Tenth Stage.

Before reaching the Tenth Stage, at least there was a goal in his mind, to view the Martial Ancestor as a target to pursue.

But after the breakthrough, upon sensing the Martial Ancestor’s presence, he realized he had no hope to catch up.

From hope to despair.

It was not a pleasant feeling.

“Yes.”

The many Perfect Demon True Lords exchanged glances and respectfully withdrew.

The shock in their hearts was immense, as the strength of the Martial Ancestor simply shattered the longstanding perceptions of the Boundless Void.

Could there really exist such a formidable being in this world?

“Wait.”

The Child of the Void seemed to have thought of something and spoke, “We must abide by the words of the Martial Ancestor just now, and we must not violate them.”

Oaths could only restrain but could not outright prevent; should a Perfect Demonic Divine Master go mad and disregard everything, the oath would not be able to constrain them.

Therefore, the Child of the Void once again warned the many Perfect Demonic Divine Masters that they must not violate the Martial Ancestor’s command at any time.

“Yes.”

“The great Child of the Void, we are not fools.”

One after another, the Perfect Demonic Divine Masters immediately promised, the power of the Martial Ancestor exceeded their imagination, and even without the Child of the Void’s words, no one would dare to violate them.

…

“With these Demonic Divine Masters here, Martial Tao will have at least a hundred billion years of development time.”

Within the Boundless Void, Lin Yuan’s figure appeared as he silently thought.

The Boundless Void would continuously give birth to new Evil Gods. The Evil Gods of later generations, not having experienced Lin Yuan’s strength, might act against the beings within the world.

But now, those Perfect Demonic Divine Masters, as well as the Tenth Stage Child of the Void, had witnessed Lin Yuan’s methods.

With their restraint on the new Evil Gods that would be born in later generations, the situation in the Boundless Void would remain stable for a long time.

This was also the reason Lin Yuan did not slaughter all those powerful Demonic Divine Masters.

The fear those Demonic Divine Masters had for Lin Yuan would be more deterrent than an oath.

…

Tianqing World.

Before the Martial Hall.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared.

“Martial Ancestor.”

The High Priest Qingyao immediately came forth to pay her respects.

For a hundred years, Lin Yuan’s true form remained in seclusion for arduous cultivation, but his two Primordial Spirits would often appear, transporting many Martial Tao cultivators to other worlds.

“The journey to more worlds from now on will be up to you.”

Lin Yuan spoke, six hundred years of nurturing had brought the strongest batch of Martial Tao cultivators in Tianqing World to the Seventh Stage.

This was the result of Lin Yuan’s two Primordial Spirits taking some time to personally train them.

These Seventh Stage Martial Tao cultivators were rapidly promoted by Lin Yuan through certain means, with little chance for further advancement.

The purpose of forcefully nurturing these Seventh Stage Martial Tao cultivators was to ensure the spread of Martial Tao after his departure.

A Seventh Stage Martial Tao cultivator could already traverse the Void and could completely find new worlds on their own to spread Martial Tao.

Of course, compared with the protection afforded by Lin Yuan’s two Primordial Spirits, the subsequent spread and development of Martial Tao would be much slower, but it had the advantage of time.

“Alright.”

High Priest Qingyao nodded before cautiously asking, “Do you have matters to attend to, Martial Ancestor?”

Although Lin Yuan’s tone was calm all along, High Priest Qingyao still sensed something more in his voice.

“Next, I will enter seclusion, and it may be a very long time before I emerge.” Lin Yuan spoke.

The so-called seclusion meant returning to the Main Universe, and if nothing unexpected happened, Lin Yuan might not return to the Boundless Void until after a long passage of time.

And it was uncertain whether there would indeed even be such a day.

If Martial Tao could maintain its development without facing a crisis of broken succession, Lin Yuan might never descend again.

“Yes.”

High Priest Qingyao reverently responded.

“Martial Ancestor…” High Priest Qingyao wanted to say something more.

But she found that the Martial Ancestor had already vanished from in front of her.

“I wonder how long this seclusion of the Martial Ancestor will last.”

High Priest Qingyao thought to herself, then immediately busied herself once more.

As the origin world for Martial Tao, Tianqing World now had too many matters to handle every day with the rapid spread of Martial Tao.

…

Boundless Void.

Lin Yuan lay back casually, letting the tides of the Void ebb and flow, carrying him to other regions.

He spent the last year also in cultivation and understanding, and while he had reached the limits of his perception of the rules of the Boundless Void, forcing further understanding was not without gains but would be much less efficient.

Time passed by.

A year went by in a blink.

Woosh.

Lin Yuan’s figure disappeared.

When he appeared again, he was already inside the Ancestral Demon Tree of Tianqing World.

His mind and will returned, and this Martial Ancestor Golden Body naturally could not be cast aside but was placed in the safest location.

For the next descent, this safest place

was naturally the interior of Tianqing World’s Ancestral Demon Tree.

In terms of strength, the Ancestral Demon Tree was not powerful, and it could not compare to a Ninth Stage Evil God.

However, the Ancestral Demon Tree was Lin Yuan’s ‘beacon’ within the Boundless Void, able to connect with Lin Yuan’s true form in the Main Universe at any time, thereby summoning the descent.

This was where the Ancestral Demon Tree’s greatest power lay.

“The time for my stay has come.”

Lin Yuan slowly closed his eyes.

Deep in his mind, that majestic and grandiose Myriad Realms Gate suddenly shone brightly.
